text:
lina: Heads up — planning Q3 roadmap items for SOC2 evidence retention and KMS/HSM gating. Need to decide retention defaults, per-tenant export windows, and risk budget for live key rotations. Punting to thread for async input.
aj: Quick q: are we aligning on 13/25/90 day buckets or something custom per customer?
maria: From compliance POV customers ask 90d min for logs, but some enterprise legal wants 7 yrs for audit artifacts. We'll need export/archival flow.
tom: Operational concern: HSM-backed rotations add downtime window if we require coordinated shard rotation. Need SLO impact calc.
sam-pricing: Cost modeling: hot vs cold storage, per-GB egress, KMS API ops. I can mock numbers if we pick retention tiers.
lina: Proposed launch gating: 1) audit-export API v1 with tenant scoping; 2) KMS integration with rotation & soft-delete; 3) retention policy UI + infra enforcement; 4) runbook for e-discovery. Thoughts?
aj: Agree but curious about default: make 90d default for logs, 1y for audit exports? Keep shorter defaults to be PLG-friendly but require enterprise opt-in for long term.
maria: We can't default to <90d for audit evidence; SOC2 requires evidence availability for the audit period. Recommend default 90d and explicit opt-in for extended retention with contract terms.
tom: Runbooks: add automated alerting when HSM key usage exceeds threshold, and fallback policy to software keystore in emergencies w/ audit trail.
aj: Fallback = big risk. Need explicit security review and opt-in per customer — maybe allow only for non-PHI tenants.
lina: @maria can you draft minimal launch acceptance criteria for compliance sign-off? e.g., documented retention enforcement, export integrity checks (hashes), KMS/HSM audit logs captured.
maria: Yep. I'll draft criteria: retention enforced via immutable TTL; export zip with SHA256; export auth via tenant admin + 2FA; KMS/HSM audit events ingested into SIEM; evidence retention tests in CI.
sam-pricing: For numbers, cold archive @ $0.02/GB/month, hot @ $0.15/GB/month, egress $0.05/GB. For a 1TB customer storing 7yrs ~ estimate $168/yr cold vs $1,800/yr hot. Need to communicate to sales.
tom: Question about HSM rotation policy: can we support staggered rollouts so no global outage? Runtime needs to route existing sessions to old key's decrypt path until KV cache expires.
aj: We have runtime support for multi-key read but only single-write. Should be doable with a migration window plus KV-cache TTL extension.
lina: Decision items assigned: maria -> compliance criteria + customer-facing docs; sam -> cost impacts and pricing options; aj -> migration plan with runtime team; tom -> runbook + monitoring alerts. Target: have PRDs by next Fri.
audit-bot: Incident: last-keystore-rotation: no impact; metrics: 0.02% failed decrypts during rollouts (observed).
maria: One more: legal wants ability to put data on legal hold independent of retention TTLs. Need export-hold feature.
aj: We can implement hold flag that overrides TTL and prevents deletion. Need retention UI and API.
lina: Okay locking: default retention 90d logs/1y audit exports, opt-in extended retention, legal-hold API, HSM rotation with staggered rollout, audit-export API v1. Will review PRDs next week.
tom: :thumbsup: I'll start runbook draft and schedule tabletop.
sam-pricing: I'll post a short spreadsheet with cost examples and potential surcharge for extended retention.
maria: Thanks — I'll include the legal-hold flow in the compliance doc.
